newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU signs cooperation deal with Macedonia.
newsitem.headline: EU signs cooperation deal with Macedonia.

text.p: The European Union on Tuesday signed a cooperation deal with Macedonia, the former Yugoslavian state taking the opportunity to stress its ultimate goal was full membership of the bloc.
"The Republic of Macedonia is firmly committed to associating and gaining the status of full member of the European Union," Macedonian President Branko Crvenkovski said at the signing ceremony.

Dutch Foreign Minister Hans Van Mierlo, speaking for the Dutch EU presidency, said the accord, covering areas like trade, economic cooperation and involving EU financial aid, would help develop Macedonia develop its economic potential.

"The EU believes that the agreement will support your efforts and that it will contribute to an increasing prosperity and a long lasting stability in your country and in the region as a whole," Van Mierlo said.
